details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: heap buffer overflows and out-of-bounds read in index
     handling
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-42617_CVE-2026-46572_CVE-2026-56136.patch:
       validate the index entry stream and INDEX_ROOT.index_block_size read
       from disk, and check the size copied from the index root to the new
       index block in ntfs_ir_to_ib(), in include/ntfs-3g/index.h,
       libntfs-3g/attrib.c and libntfs-3g/index.c.
     - CVE-2026-42617
     - CVE-2026-46572
     - CVE-2026-56136
   * SECURITY UPDATE: heap buffer overflow in index block split
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-46569.patch: bound tail_size against the
       destination block capacity in ntfs_ib_copy_tail() in
       libntfs-3g/index.c.
     - CVE-2026-46569
   * SECURITY UPDATE: out-of-bounds write when walking a deep index
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-46570.patch: limit the B-tree depth to
       MAX_PARENT_VCN in ntfs_index_walk_down() in libntfs-3g/index.c.
     - CVE-2026-46570
   * Fix double free when an index entry is too long to hold a VCN
     - debian/patches/index-reject-entry-too-long-for-vcn.patch: reject an
       index entry that is too long to hold a VCN in ntfs_ie_add_vcn() in
       libntfs-3g/index.c, as its 16-bit length would wrap to zero.
   * SECURITY UPDATE: heap buffer overflow in LZNT1 decompression
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-42618.patch: end a sub-block when its output
       is full and check the input bounds before reading sub-block headers
       and phrase tokens in ntfs_decompress() in libntfs-3g/compress.c, and
       zero the unused part of the output when the compressed data is garbled.
     - CVE-2026-42618
   * SECURITY UPDATE: heap buffer overflow in ntfscat
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-42616.patch: size the read buffer from the
       block size in cat() in ntfsprogs/ntfscat.c.
     - CVE-2026-42616
